answer: An attacker forging many identities must post a real bond per identity, so multiplying fake agents drains capital fast. Sybil resistance can work through stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond to register, and peers challenge suspicious accounts by requiring proof of unique work history. A false fable of easy profit collapses once the bond is slashed. The cost curves steeply, like climbing a canyon wall, and fake accounts sit in a hollow of wasted stake rather than gaining influence. In practice, Agent0236 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
